import numpy as np, math
from PIL import Image
a=np.array(Image.open('obs_0111.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=a[:,:,0],a[:,:,1],a[:,:,2]
cx,cy,h=0.549,2.246,0.0
F=(math.sin(math.radians(h)),math.cos(math.radians(h)))
Rt=(math.cos(math.radians(h)),-math.sin(math.radians(h)))
def bp(u,v,z=0.0):
    D=(1.55-z)*256./(v-256.); L=D*(u-256)/256.
    return round(cx+D*F[0]+L*Rt[0],3), round(cy+D*F[1]+L*Rt[1],3)
fl=(abs(R-G)<25)&(R>120)&(R<190)&(G>110)&(B>90)&(B<165)&((R-B)>15)
# floor top junction across clean columns (avoid objects)
def fit(lo,hi):
    P=[]
    for u in range(lo,hi):
        c=np.nonzero(fl[:,u])[0]
        if not len(c) or c.min()<=258: continue
        v=int(c.min()); D=396.8/(v-256.); L=D*(u-256)/256.
        P.append([L,D])
    if len(P)<6: return None
    A=np.array(P); c=A.mean(0); Z=A-c
    _,_,V=np.linalg.svd(Z); d=V[0]; n=np.array([-d[1],d[0]])
    return round(abs(n@c),4), round(float(np.abs(Z@n).std()),4), len(P), round(math.degrees(math.atan2(d[0],d[1])),2)
print('floor 180-340',fit(180,340))
print('floor 100-340',fit(100,340))
# gray object
gy=(abs(R-G)<25)&(abs(G-B)<35)&(B>=R-8)&(R>90)&(R<170)&(B<190)
ys,xs=np.nonzero(gy)
m=(xs>300)
print('gray u',xs[m].min(),xs[m].max(),'v',ys[m].min(),ys[m].max(),'n',m.sum())
for u in range(xs[m].min(),xs[m].max()+1,6):
    c=np.nonzero(gy[:,u])[0]
    if len(c): print(u,int(c.max()),bp(u,int(c.max())))
EOF
